# Test fixtures directory

This directory contains sample Langfuse traces used for testing.

## Fixtures

- `sample_trace_success.json`: A successful agent execution trace with XML module format
- `sample_trace_failure.json`: A failed agent execution trace with errors (budget violation)
- `sample_trace_minimal.json`: Minimal trace structure for edge case testing
- `sample_trace_plaintext.json`: Plain text agent responses requiring LLM decomposition
